parsed.name: 海洋光学光谱仪
parsed.description: 一类紧凑型实验室光谱仪，用于测量光强随波长的分布，常用于吸收、透射、反射、荧光和光源表征等光学实验。部分型号可带快门、内置光源、辐照度校准、热电制冷和电子存储等功能。
parsed.description_en: A family of compact laboratory spectrometers used to measure light intensity as a function of wavelength. They are commonly used for optical measurements such as absorption, transmission, reflection, fluorescence, and light-source characterization. Some models may include features such as a shutter, built-in light source, irradiance calibration, thermoelectric cooling, and onboard memory.
